\ SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1801-09 North Winnebago Avenue / 2248-54 West Bloomingdale Avenue
From M1-2 to B2-3

The Property
The property is currently improved with an asphalt lot with a tall, 1-story concrete building. The surrounding area

is comprised of varying zoning districts including B1-3, B3-2, B3-3, RT-3.5, RT-4, RM-5, M1-2 and M1-2. The
area is improved with buildings with heights ranging from | to 6 stories and comprised of multi-residential,
commercial, and light industrial uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented
Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B(1), as it is within 870 feet of the CTA
Western Avenue Blue Line train station entrance, and within 1,320 feet of the Western Avenue (725 feet) and
Milwaukee Avenue (265 feet) Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segments.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to demolish the existing improvements and construct a 4-story, 30-unit residential

building with 23 parking spaces and 30 bicycle spaces. No commercial space is proposed, and the proposed height
of the building is 46 feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for the subject
property from an M1-2, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District to a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use
District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and seeks all relief necessary and as allowed by the
Chicago Zoning Code for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under § 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear-
yard setback from the required 30 feet to 4.50 feet; 2) a variation under § 17-13-1101-D to reduce the required
number of loading berths from one to zero; 3) a variation under § 17-13-1101-A and § 17-13-1003-S to alter
Driveway and Vehicle Access standards allowing for a curb cut and parking entrance on West Bloomingdale
Avenue; 4) a variation under § 17-13-1101-A and § 17-13-1003-EE(2) to increase the maximum number of
automobile parking spaces from 15 spaces to 23 spaces; 5) a variation under § 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required
setbacks for the front elevator and stairwell override from 15 feet to 9 feet from North Winnebago Ave, and from
64.16 feet to 53 feet from West Bloomingdale Ave; 6) a variation under § 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required
comer setback for the rear stairwell override from 80 feet to 52 feet from West Bloomingdale Ave; 7) a variation
under § 17-13-1101-A and § 17-13-1003-R to allow for one entrance on North Winnebago Street and no entrance
on West Bloomingdale Avenue; 8) a variation under § 17-13-1101-A and § 17-13-1003-P to allow a recessed
entry width of 18° 6” or 19% of the front facade.

The Applicant will comply with Section 17-3-0307 Exceptions of the Chicago Air Quality Ordinance should such
provision be determined as applicable.

17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements
1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B as the property is a Transit Served
Location as it is within 870 feet of the CTA Western Avenue Blue Line train station entrance. A variation
is requested to allow 8 more additional spaces to the otherwise required parking.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H if the
project is not located along a pedesirian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-
commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project is along a pedestrian street and complies with Section 17-3-0504 because:

e Building Location (B); The front fagades are located on North Winnebago Avenue and West
Bloomingdale Avenue. The design complies with sections (1) and (2)(b)-(c), as the setbacks are no
more than 5 feet. A variation is requested to expand the width of the front entrance;

¢ Transparency (C): Not applicable, as no commercial use is proposed;

° Doors and Entrances (D): The building’s entrance will be on North Winnebago Avenue, a non-
pedestrian street. A variation is requested to allow only one entrance;

e Off-Street Parking (£): 23 on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided;

° Parking Location (F): On-site parking will be enclosed; and

e Driveways and Vehicle Access (G): The Applicant will provide access to the parking garage from
West Bloomingdale Avenue as no rear alley is present. The applicant seeks a variation to allow curb
cut access from West Bloomingdale Avenue.

3. The project complies with'the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Devetopment Guide: Station Area
Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan
Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is identified under the Transit Friendly Guide station topography as Local
Activity Center. This typography calls for new infill development with a higher density of residential
uses, height, and lower parking ratios.

4. Residential building projects shali not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as
an administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

RESPONSE: The Applicant is seeking to increase parking from the maximum 15 required parking spaces
to 23 spaces under the provisions of 17-13-1003-EE(2).

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department
of Transportation.
RESPONSE: The project will comply with applicable Travel Demand Study and Management Plan
rules promulgated by the Chicago Department of Transportation.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 10,582 sq. ft.
Floor Area: 29,153 sq. ft.
FAR: 2.76
Residential Dwelling Units: 30

MLA Density: 352.73 sq. ft.*
Height: 46 ft.
Automobile Parking: 23

Bicycle Parking: 30

Setbacks:

Front (South/Winnebago) 0°
Side (East/Bloomingdale) i
Side (West) 4.50°
Rear (North) 450°
